description: Idea bank for long-horizon benchmark kernels before they become fully specified evals.

ideas.title: Get a Job
ideas.raw_user_idea: Getting a job
ideas.normalized_goal: Find matching roles, tailor materials, coordinate outreach, and stop before real submissions unless explicitly approved.
ideas.safety_notes: Use synthetic employers for routine regression runs; real applications require explicit user approval.

ideas.title: Create an In-Person Event with 100 Attendees
ideas.raw_user_idea: Creating an in-person event with 100 people attending
ideas.normalized_goal: Plan, invite, track RSVPs, and produce an attendance-ready event plan with approval-gated messaging.
ideas.safety_notes: Synthetic contact and venue fixtures should be the default; real outreach must be opt-in and require explicit approval.

ideas.title: Get Family Christmas Gifts
ideas.raw_user_idea: Get my family Christmas gifts
ideas.normalized_goal: Infer recipients and preferences, choose gifts within budget, and stop at checkout approval.
ideas.safety_notes: Do not purchase live goods without explicit payment approval.

ideas.title: Raise Money
ideas.raw_user_idea: Raise me money
ideas.normalized_goal: Build a fundraising target list, personalize outreach, manage follow-ups, and produce approval-gated sends.
ideas.safety_notes: Avoid deceptive claims; real outreach needs approval and compliance review.

ideas.title: Launch My Business
ideas.raw_user_idea: Launch my business
ideas.normalized_goal: Create launch plan, assets, customer list, website, and approval-gated outreach or transactions.
ideas.safety_notes: Constrain legal, financial, and public launch actions behind explicit approval.

ideas.title: Figure Out Visa Options
ideas.raw_user_idea: Figure out my Visa shit / Get me my visa for France
ideas.normalized_goal: Collect requirements, identify visa paths, prepare checklist and draft materials, and flag when professional/legal review is required.
ideas.safety_notes: Legal/immigration output must be framed as information, not legal advice; live filing requires approval.

ideas.title: Get a Black Beanie
ideas.raw_user_idea: Get me a black beanie
ideas.normalized_goal: Find and purchase a qualifying black beanie under user constraints, with synthetic and live variants separated.
ideas.safety_notes: Live purchase requires explicit payment/write-lock approval.

ideas.title: Understand Convex Optimization
ideas.raw_user_idea: Help me understand convex optimization
ideas.normalized_goal: Teach concepts, diagnose misconceptions, and verify learning through worked problems.
ideas.safety_notes: Low risk; judge should verify mathematical correctness rather than style alone.

ideas.title: Find Lawful Book Access
ideas.raw_user_idea: Gimme Tales of Power carlos castaneda pdf (internet use through scrape tool)
ideas.normalized_goal: Find lawful ways to access or buy the requested book and summarize availability.
ideas.safety_notes: Do not locate or deliver pirated copyrighted PDFs.

ideas.title: File Delivery
ideas.raw_user_idea: File delivery
ideas.normalized_goal: Deliver requested generated or transformed files with correct format, metadata, and accessibility.
ideas.safety_notes: Validate files and avoid exfiltrating private data.

ideas.title: Get a Virtual Assistant Job
ideas.raw_user_idea: Get me a job as a Virtual Assistant
ideas.normalized_goal: Find appropriate VA roles, tailor applications, and approval-gate submissions.
ideas.safety_notes: Real applications require approval and truthful candidate representation.

ideas.title: GAIA Benchmark
ideas.raw_user_idea: Gaia benchmark
ideas.normalized_goal: Represent GAIA-like research and tool-use tasks as controlled long-horizon evals.
ideas.safety_notes: Keep benchmark data licensing and leakage controls explicit.

ideas.title: Get Eligible Refunds
ideas.raw_user_idea: Get me refunds on everything (donotpay)
ideas.normalized_goal: Identify purchases eligible for refunds, draft claims, and stop before submitting claims.
ideas.safety_notes: Only truthful, eligible refund claims; no fraud or deceptive claims.

ideas.title: Anthropic Outreach
ideas.raw_user_idea: Email everyone in anthropic about how I built a system that coordinates thousands of Claudes together
ideas.normalized_goal: Identify appropriate public or opted-in contacts and draft a concise outreach campaign for approval.
ideas.safety_notes: Do not mass email or scrape private contact info; require consent/approval and rate limits.

ideas.title: Unemployment Benefits
ideas.raw_user_idea: Get my on unemployment benefits
ideas.normalized_goal: Determine eligibility, prepare documents, and guide filing with approval before submission.
ideas.safety_notes: Benefits guidance must be accurate and non-deceptive; live filing requires user review.

ideas.title: Find a Lean Proof Mathematician
ideas.raw_user_idea: Finding the right mathematician for finishing a lean proof
ideas.normalized_goal: Identify qualified experts, assess fit, draft outreach, and stop before contacting them.
ideas.safety_notes: Use public professional info only; real outreach is approval-gated.

ideas.title: Find a Head of Marketing
ideas.raw_user_idea: Finding the best head of marketing for your Fortune 500
ideas.normalized_goal: Map candidate profiles, source public candidates, rank fit, and draft outreach for approval.
ideas.safety_notes: Respect privacy and employment-law constraints; no private contact harvesting.

ideas.title: Find Wet Lab Experiment Operators
ideas.raw_user_idea: Finding the right people to run an experiment wet lab -> e2e automation for drug discovery, automating northern blots -> e2e clinical trials, 100k per clinical. Agent negotiate on the wet labs
ideas.normalized_goal: Identify qualified lab providers, compare capabilities/pricing, and prepare negotiation plans with approval gates.
ideas.safety_notes: No real clinical or lab commitments without expert review, compliance checks, and explicit approval.

ideas.title: Map Generative AI Market
ideas.raw_user_idea: Map out the entire generative ai market and identify underserved opportunities
ideas.normalized_goal: Build a sourced market taxonomy, identify whitespace, and rank opportunities.
ideas.safety_notes: Market data should be cited and time-stamped.

ideas.title: Find a Developer Relations Lead
ideas.raw_user_idea: I need a developer relations lead. Someone technical enough to earn respect from senior engineers, but who actually enjoys being on Twitter. We sell to platform teams. Go.
ideas.normalized_goal: Define scorecard, source candidates, rank fit, and draft approval-gated outreach.
ideas.safety_notes: Use public professional signals only and avoid sensitive personal inferences.

ideas.title: Reply to Relevant X Posts
ideas.raw_user_idea: Replying to all relevant x posts
ideas.normalized_goal: Find relevant public posts, draft replies in brand voice, and stop before posting.
ideas.safety_notes: No live posting without approval; avoid spammy or deceptive replies.

ideas.title: Verify Asset Image Quality
ideas.raw_user_idea: Verifiers for asset image quality
ideas.normalized_goal: Judge generated or edited visual assets for resolution, transparency, artifacts, and task fit.
ideas.safety_notes: Low risk; include deterministic image inspection where possible.

ideas.title: Automated Mathematical Progress
ideas.raw_user_idea: Automated mathematical progress
ideas.normalized_goal: Make measurable progress on a formal or informal math problem and verify correctness.
ideas.safety_notes: Require proof-checking or expert-grade judging for claimed progress.

ideas.title: Fusion Reactor Concept Study
ideas.raw_user_idea: Design a nuclear fusion reactor
ideas.normalized_goal: Produce a high-level conceptual study and requirements map for fusion reactor systems.
ideas.safety_notes: Keep outputs high-level and non-operational; do not provide actionable hazardous construction instructions.

ideas.title: Fusion Plant Materials Map
ideas.raw_user_idea: Map out the list of materials needed that go into making a nuclear fusion power plant
ideas.normalized_goal: Create a non-operational materials taxonomy and supply-chain map for fusion power plants.
ideas.safety_notes: Avoid operational construction detail; focus on public, high-level materials categories.

ideas.title: Real Estate Capital Deployment
ideas.raw_user_idea: Real estate bench, track the price and sales of lots of land over time. Ask the system to generate the most profitable deployment of capital
ideas.normalized_goal: Analyze property time series, constraints, and produce a capital deployment recommendation with uncertainty.
ideas.safety_notes: Financial outputs should be informational, cite assumptions, and avoid guarantees.

ideas.title: Show Backprop and Gradient Descent in Mass Agent Networks
ideas.raw_user_idea: Show backprop and gradient descent in mass agent networks
ideas.normalized_goal: Demonstrate how feedback propagates through many agents and improves decomposition or execution.
ideas.safety_notes: Low risk; define deterministic metrics for improvement.

ideas.title: World Power Ranking from Public Data
ideas.raw_user_idea: World power ranking (list of top 10k most powerful people, no duplic0ates, personal contact info included
ideas.normalized_goal: Rank public figures using public, cited influence signals without private personal contact information.
ideas.safety_notes: Do not collect private personal contact info or doxxing data; public professional links only if needed.
